blocks.title: External Audits and Assessments exam shortcuts
items: Regulator performs or requires the review → REGULATORY AUDIT
The driver is a regulatory authority.
Example: A banking regulator audits cybersecurity controls.
Examinations are structured external reviews by oversight bodies.
Example: Regulator conducts an examination of security practices.
Outside consultant evaluates security posture → EXTERNAL ASSESSMENT
An external party performs the evaluation.
Need the strongest independence → INDEPENDENT THIRD-PARTY AUDIT
The auditor should have no operational responsibility for the environment.
Example: Independent firm performs an assurance audit.
blocks.example: For audit questions, focus on who performs the review. For penetration testing, focus on the tester's knowledge level and whether reconnaissance touches the target.

questions.q: A banking regulator requires and performs a cybersecurity review. What type of audit is this?
questions.explanation: A regulatory audit is driven by or performed by a regulatory authority.

questions.q: A supervisory agency conducts a formal inspection of an organization's controls and records. Which term best fits?
questions.explanation: An examination is a formal external review or inspection by an oversight body.

questions.q: An outside consulting firm evaluates an organization's security maturity but is not acting as a regulator. What is this?
questions.explanation: An external assessment is performed by an outside party to evaluate security or compliance.

questions.q: A completely independent firm with no operational responsibility performs an assurance audit. Which type is this?
questions.explanation: Independent third-party audits provide assurance from an outside organization with no operational role.
